$comment: How each target in contributing/inventory/data/token-map.json landed in the DTCG tokens (#18). Targets that exist as built tokens need no entry. Every other target is listed here: superseded (with the tokens that replace it), dropped, or deferred to a later issue. packages/tokens/test/phase-0-map.test.ts keeps this file complete and checks every replacement exists.

--apui-surface-glass-opacity.reason: One glass recipe (D-005): the 80% opacity floor is the alpha of --apui-surface-glass.

--apui-surface-glass-tint.reason: Glass is a neutral surface (D-006). Tinted glass would break the contrast floor checked against black, white, red and blue backdrops.

--apui-surface-glass-border-opacity.reason: The rim is one color token with its alpha built in.

--apui-surface-glass-border-width.reason: Glass uses the same 1px edge as every container.

--apui-surface-glass-highlight.reason: The brand book rules out rim lighting and glows.

--apui-surface-glass-highlight-opacity.reason: The brand book rules out rim lighting and glows.

--apui-surface-glass-shadow-color.reason: The glass shadow is one shadow token per theme.

--apui-surface-glass-shadow-opacity.reason: The glass shadow is one shadow token per theme.

--apui-datepicker-*.reason: DatePicker component tokens arrive with the DatePicker rebuild; flatpickr's future was open in the audit (question 12).

--apui-datepicker-radius.reason: The field uses the field radius and the calendar the popover radius.

--apui-datepicker-padding.reason: Component token, added with the DatePicker rebuild.

--apui-datepicker-cell-size.reason: Component token, added with the DatePicker rebuild.

--apui-datepicker-day-hover-bg.reason: Hover is the shared hover wash.

--apui-datepicker-day-hover-text.reason: Hover keeps the default text color.

--apui-datepicker-selected-bg.reason: The chosen date uses the shared selected fill.

--apui-datepicker-today-bg.reason: Component token, added with the DatePicker rebuild.

--apui-datepicker-today-text.reason: Component token, added with the DatePicker rebuild.

--apui-transition-property-*.reason: Which properties animate is a component decision, written in each component's CSS. Timing comes from the motion tokens.

--apui-transition-*.reason: Semantic durations and easings replace the transition shorthands.

--apui-shadow-*.reason: A named elevation set replaces the shadow scale (D-005, audit question 9). Shadows mark only what floats.

--apui-font-size-*.reason: Sizes live in the type styles (type.<style>.font-size), not in a free scale.

--apui-letter-spacing-*.reason: Tracking lives in the type styles (type.<style>.letter-spacing).

--apui-line-height-*.reason: Line heights live in the type styles (type.<style>.line-height).

--apui-type-letter-spacing.reason: Tracking lives in the type styles.

--apui-type-letter-spacing-wide.reason: The one wide tracking is the eyebrow style.

--apui-type-line-height.reason: Line heights live in the type styles.

--apui-type-line-height-*.reason: Line heights live in the type styles.

--apui-font-scale.reason: Larger-text accessibility presets are decided with the theme presets (audit question 7).

--apui-button-border-width.reason: Every control outline uses the shared border width.

--apui-tabs-border-width.reason: The tab list edge uses the border width and the active underline the selected indicator width.

--apui-color-*0.reason: Generated primary, secondary and accent shades become the steel, slate and marigold ramps plus the seven color roles.

--apui-target-size-touch.reason: One minimum target (WCAG 2.5.8). Touch-first screens pick the lg control size.

--apui-disabled-bg.reason: Disabled controls keep their surface and switch to the disabled text color, paired with aria-disabled.

--apui-disabled-opacity.reason: Opacity fades text below contrast on some surfaces; disabled uses --apui-text-disabled instead.

--apui-chart-axis-label.reason: Axis labels and ticks share one token.

--apui-chart-font-size.reason: Chart text uses the caption style.

--apui-chart-bg.reason: A chart sits on its container's surface.

--apui-chart-text.reason: Chart text uses the text roles.

--apui-chart-data-label.reason: Direct labels use the default text color.

--apui-chart-stroke-width.reason: Component token, added with the Chart rebuild.

--apui-gap-*.reason: Density resolves gaps per mode (#22). For custom spacing, multiply a space token by --apui-density.
